/-!
# Reflected removable divided differences

The first divided difference absorbs the two signs in an anti-reflection: one from the
numerator and one from reflection of the affine denominator.  The identity remains exact on
the diagonal because `dslope` uses the derivative there.  Applied to a two-variable numerator,
this says that an anti-invariant numerator has a reflection-invariant removable diagonal
quotient.

This is source-independent bridge infrastructure.  It is an elementary law of divided
differences, not a new hypertranscendence theorem.
-/

open Complex

namespace HTGeometry

noncomputable section

/-- **Reflected divided-difference law.**  Simultaneous negation of the argument and anchor,
together with negation of the reflected function, leaves the removable divided difference
unchanged.  No differentiability hypothesis is needed: at the diagonal the two chain-rule signs
cancel, while away from it the two quotient signs cancel algebraically. -/
theorem dslope_neg_comp_neg (T : ℂ → ℂ) (a z : ℂ) :
    dslope (fun w => -T (-w)) (-a) z = dslope T a (-z) := by
  by_cases hz : z = -a
  · subst z
    rw [dslope_same, neg_neg, dslope_same]
    have hcomp := iteratedDeriv_comp_neg 1 T (-a)
    have hneg := iteratedDeriv_neg 1 (fun w : ℂ => T (-w)) (-a)
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_one] at hcomp
    rw [iteratedDeriv_one, iteratedDeriv_one] at hneg
    have hfun : (fun w : ℂ => -T (-w)) = -(fun w : ℂ => T (-w)) := rfl
    rw [hfun, hneg, hcomp]
    ring_nf
  · have hnz : -z ≠ a := by
      intro h
      apply hz
      simpa using congrArg Neg.neg h
    rw [dslope_of_ne _ hz, dslope_of_ne _ hnz,
      slope_def_module, slope_def_module]
    simp only [neg_neg, smul_eq_mul]
    have hden : -z - a = -(z - -a) := by ring
    have hnum : -T (-z) - -T a = -(T (-z) - T a) := by ring
    rw [hden, hnum, inv_neg]
    ring

/-- **Vector-valued divided-slope/Taylor-jet law.**  Over every complete characteristic-zero
normed field, `k!` times the center value after `k` removable divided slopes of an analytic map
into any complete normed space is its `k`-th derivative.  Thus the full divided-difference chain
is the normalized analytic jet, not merely at the first step. -/
theorem factorial_nsmul_iterate_dslope_self_eq_iteratedDeriv
    {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] [CharZero 𝕜]
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : 𝕜 → E} {a : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f a) (k : ℕ) :
    k.factorial • (Function.swap dslope a)^[k] f a =
      iteratedDeriv k f a := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  have hcenter : (Function.swap dslope a)^[k] f a = p.coeff k := by
    rw [← (hp.has_fpower_series_iterate_dslope_fslope k).coeff_zero 1,
      ← FormalMultilinearSeries.coeff,
      FormalMultilinearSeries.coeff_iterate_fslope, zero_add]
  rw [hcenter]
  obtain ⟨r, hr⟩ := hp
  have hfac := hr.factorial_smul (1 : 𝕜) k
  rw [iteratedFDeriv_apply_eq_iteratedDeriv_mul_prod,
    Finset.prod_const_one, one_smul] at hfac
  change k.factorial • p.coeff k = iteratedDeriv k f a at hfac
  exact hfac

/-- Scalar division form of the vector-valued divided-slope/Taylor-jet law. -/
theorem iterate_dslope_self_eq_iteratedDeriv_div_factorial
    {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] [CharZero 𝕜]
    {f : 𝕜 → 𝕜} {a : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f a) (k : ℕ) :
    (Function.swap dslope a)^[k] f a =
      iteratedDeriv k f a / (k.factorial : 𝕜) := by
  rw [eq_div_iff (Nat.cast_ne_zero.mpr k.factorial_ne_zero)]
  simpa only [nsmul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using
    factorial_nsmul_iterate_dslope_self_eq_iteratedDeriv hf k

/-- **Removable-slope jet-shift law.**  The `k`-th center jet of the removable slope of an
analytic vector-valued map is its `(k + 1)`-st jet, with the exact factor `k + 1`.  This is the
one-step form of the full divided-difference/Taylor-jet law. -/
theorem succ_smul_iteratedDeriv_dslope_self
    {𝕜 : Type*} [NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜] [CompleteSpace 𝕜] [CharZero 𝕜]
    {E : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace 𝕜 E] [CompleteSpace E]
    {f : 𝕜 → E} {a : 𝕜} (hf : AnalyticAt 𝕜 f a) (k : ℕ) :
    (k + 1 : 𝕜) • iteratedDeriv k (dslope f a) a =
      iteratedDeriv (k + 1) f a := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hf
  have hg : AnalyticAt 𝕜 (dslope f a) a :=
    hp.has_fpower_series_dslope_fslope.analyticAt
  have hk := factorial_nsmul_iterate_dslope_self_eq_iteratedDeriv hg k
  have hk1 :=
    factorial_nsmul_iterate_dslope_self_eq_iteratedDeriv hp.analyticAt (k + 1)
  rw [← hk, ← hk1]
  have hiter :
      (Function.swap dslope a)^[k] (dslope f a) a =
        (Function.swap dslope a)^[k + 1] f a := by
    rw [Function.iterate_succ_apply]
  rw [hiter]
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul 𝕜, ← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul 𝕜,
    smul_smul, Nat.factorial_succ, Nat.cast_mul]
  simp only [Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]

/-- Scalar division form of the removable-slope jet-shift law. -/

zeros; a multiple zero requires the entire depth-`m` chain.

Multiplication by the spectral coordinate acts on successive chain members by a Jordan recurrence.
This identifies the precise additional state which a multiplicity-faithful completion must carry.
-/

open Complex Set Filter Function FormalMultilinearSeries
open scoped Topology

noncomputable section

namespace RHTower

/-- The canonical `k`-fold removable quotient of `XiC` at `alpha`. -/
def xiThetaDividedChain (alpha : ℂ) (k : ℕ) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  (Function.swap dslope alpha)^[k] XiC

@[simp] theorem xiThetaDividedChain_zero (alpha : ℂ) :
    xiThetaDividedChain alpha 0 = XiC := by
  rfl

/-- Every member of the canonical divided chain is entire. -/
theorem xiThetaDividedChain_analyticAt (alpha : ℂ) (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (xiThetaDividedChain alpha k) z := by
  induction k generalizing z with
  | zero =>
      exact XiC_analytic z (Set.mem_univ z)
  | succ k ih =>
      rw [xiThetaDividedChain, Function.iterate_succ_apply']
      exact analyticAt_dslope_of_analyticAt (ih alpha) (ih z)

/-- Every center value in the Xi divided chain is the corresponding factorially normalized Xi
jet.  Thus the removable Hedenmalm chain and the Taylor jet are the same local data at every
complex base point, without a zero or multiplicity hypothesis. -/
theorem xiThetaDividedChain_self_eq_iteratedDeriv_div_factorial
    (alpha : ℂ) (k : ℕ) :
    xiThetaDividedChain alpha k alpha =
      iteratedDeriv k XiC alpha / k.factorial := by
  simpa only [xiThetaDividedChain] using
    HTGeometry.iterate_dslope_self_eq_iteratedDeriv_div_factorial
      (XiC_analytic alpha (Set.mem_univ alpha)) k

/-- **Graded Xi jet reflection.**  The `k`-th jet of the centered even Xi function has parity
`(-1)^k`.  This subsumes the previously separate oddness law for the first derivative. -/
theorem iteratedDeriv_XiC_neg (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    iteratedDeriv k XiC (-z) =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * iteratedDeriv k XiC z := by
  have heven : (fun w : ℂ => XiC (-w)) = XiC := by
    funext w
    exact XiC_even w
  calc
    iteratedDeriv k XiC (-z) =
        iteratedDeriv k (fun w : ℂ => XiC (-w)) (-z) := by rw [heven]
    _ = (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * iteratedDeriv k XiC z := by
      simpa only [neg_neg, smul_eq_mul] using iteratedDeriv_comp_neg k XiC (-z)

/-- The center values of the full removable Xi chain obey the same graded reflection. -/
theorem xiThetaDividedChain_self_neg (k : ℕ) (z : ℂ) :
    xiThetaDividedChain (-z) k (-z) =
      (-1 : ℂ) ^ k * xiThetaDividedChain z k z := by
  rw [xiThetaDividedChain_self_eq_iteratedDeriv_div_factorial,
    xiThetaDividedChain_self_eq_iteratedDeriv_div_factorial,
    iteratedDeriv_XiC_neg]
  ring

/-- Analytic multiplicity of one centered Xi divisor support point. -/
def xiSupportMultiplicity (rho : XiDivisorSupport) : ℕ :=
  Int.toNat ((MeromorphicOn.divisor xi Set.univ) (rho : ℂ))

/-- Exact local-order law for the canonical divided chain. The first nonzero center value occurs
at precisely the analytic multiplicity, and that terminal quotient is the zero-free local
cofactor. -/
theorem xiThetaDividedChain_local_order
    (rho : XiDivisorSupport) :
    let alpha := xiSpectralPointSupport rho
    let m := xiSupportMultiplicity rho
    (∀ k < m, xiThetaDividedChain alpha k alpha = 0) ∧
      xiThetaDividedChain alpha m alpha ≠ 0 ∧
      ∀ z, XiC z = (z - alpha) ^ m * xiThetaDividedChain alpha m z := by
  dsimp only
  let alpha := xiSpectralPointSupport rho
  let m := xiSupportMultiplicity rho
  have hXi : AnalyticAt ℂ XiC alpha := XiC_analytic alpha (Set.mem_univ alpha)
  obtain ⟨p, hp⟩ := hXi
  have hpne : p ≠ 0 := by
    intro hpzero
    have hlocal : ∀ᶠ z in 𝓝 alpha, XiC z = 0 := hp.locally_zero_iff.mpr hpzero
    exact XiC_order_ne_top alpha (analyticOrderAt_eq_top.mpr hlocal)
  have horderXi : analyticOrderAt XiC alpha = (p.order : ℕ∞) := by
    apply (AnalyticAt.analyticOrderAt_eq_natCast hp.analyticAt).mpr
    refine ⟨xiThetaDividedChain alpha p.order,
      xiThetaDividedChain_analyticAt alpha p.order alpha,
      ?_, ?_⟩
    · exact hp.iterate_dslope_fslope_ne_zero hpne
    · exact Filter.Eventually.of_forall (fun z => by
        simpa only [xiThetaDividedChain, smul_eq_mul] using
          hp.eq_pow_order_mul_iterate_dslope z)
  have hpm : p.order = m := by
    have horders : (p.order : ℕ∞) = (m : ℕ∞) := by
      rw [← horderXi]
      simpa only [alpha, m, xiSupportMultiplicity] using
        XiC_analyticOrderAt_support rho
    exact ENat.coe_inj.mp horders
  constructor

/-
# Chen--Gupta--Li non-principal detector regularity

The non-principal branch of the zero-detection contour has no Dirichlet
`L`-function pole.  This module makes that dichotomy explicit: its zero
certificates carry non-principality as checked data, and the corresponding
shifted detector factor is analytic everywhere.  Gamma remains meromorphic,
with its local cancellation at the certified zero supplied by
`ChenGuptaLiZeroResidue`.
-/

namespace RHTower

/-- A certified critical-strip zero of a non-principal Dirichlet character. -/
structure CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero (q : ℕ) extends CGLCriticalStripLZero q where
  character_ne_one : character ≠ 1

/-- The translated finite detector factor in the non-principal branch. -/
def cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  zeroDetectionMobiusPolynomial X (q + 1) z.character (z.point + w) *
    DirichletCharacter.LFunction z.character (z.point + w)

/-- In the non-principal branch, the shifted finite detector factor is
complex differentiable everywhere. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_differentiable (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) :
    Differentiable ℂ (cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor X q z) := by
  intro w
  unfold cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor
  apply DifferentiableAt.mul
  · exact (differentiableAt_zeroDetectionMobiusPolynomial X (q + 1) z.character
      (z.point + w)).comp w
      ((differentiable_const z.point).differentiableAt.add differentiableAt_id)
  · exact (DirichletCharacter.differentiable_LFunction z.character_ne_one).differentiableAt.comp w
      ((differentiable_const z.point).differentiableAt.add differentiableAt_id)

/-- Hence the non-principal shifted detector factor is analytic at every
complex point. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_analyticAt (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) (w : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor X q z) w :=
  (cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_differentiable X q z).analyticAt w

/-- Apart from Gamma's known poles, the non-principal detector Mellin
integrand is meromorphic everywhere. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorMellinIntegrand_meromorphicAt (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) (w : ℂ) :
    MeromorphicAt (cglDetectorMellinIntegrand X q z.toCGLCriticalStripLZero) w := by
  unfold cglDetectorMellinIntegrand
  exact (Meromorphic.Gamma w).mul
    (cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_analyticAt X q z w).meromorphicAt

/-- The translated non-principal detector factor vanishes at its certified
zero. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_zero (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) :
    cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor X q z 0 = 0 := by
  simpa [cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor] using
    cglDetectorMellinIntegrand_residueCoefficient_at_criticalZero X q z.toCGLCriticalStripLZero

/-- Removable divided difference of the zero-vanishing non-principal detector
factor. -/
def cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) : ℂ → ℂ :=
  dslope (cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor X q z) 0

/-- The vanishing non-principal detector factor has the exact global linear
factor `w`, with a removable divided-difference quotient. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_eq_mul_zeroQuotient (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) (w : ℂ) :
    cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor X q z w =
      w * cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient X q z w := by
  simpa [cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient, smul_eq_mul] using
    (sub_smul_dslope_of_zero (cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_zero X q z) w).symm

/-- The divided-difference quotient is analytic at every point. -/
theorem cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient_analyticAt (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) (w : ℂ) :
    AnalyticAt ℂ (cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient X q z) w := by
  unfold cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient
  exact analyticAt_dslope_of_analyticAt
    (cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_analyticAt X q z 0)
    (cglNonprincipalDetectorFactor_analyticAt X q z w)

/-- The analytic replacement of the non-principal Mellin integrand after its
zero-cancelled Gamma pole is removed. -/
def cglNonprincipalRegularizedMellinIntegrand (X q : ℕ)
    (z : CGLNonprincipalCriticalStripLZero q) (w : ℂ) : ℂ :=
  Complex.Gamma (w + 1) * cglNonprincipalDetectorZeroQuotient X q z w

/-- Away from `w = 0`, the original non-principal detector Mellin integrand
is exactly its regularized analytic replacement. -/

/-!
# Exact transport of approximate eigenvectors through functional calculus

A real symbol continuous on a bounded self-adjoint operator's spectrum and
differentiable at the target coordinate has a continuous removable divided
difference. Functional calculus factors the transformed residual exactly through
the original residual. The resulting norm bound transports vanishing residuals
without assuming spectral membership, a spectral gap, or a bound on vector norms.
-/

open Filter Topology
namespace GaloisForLFunctions.HTGeometry
noncomputable section

private theorem continuousOn_dslope_of_differentiableAt {g : ℝ → ℝ} {S : Set ℝ} {x : ℝ}
    (hg : ContinuousOn g S) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) :
    ContinuousOn (dslope g x) S := by
  intro y hy
  by_cases hxy : y = x
  · subst y
    exact (continuousAt_dslope_same.mpr hd).continuousWithinAt
  · exact (continuousWithinAt_dslope_of_ne hxy).mpr (hg y hy)

variable {H : Type*} [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace ℂ H] [CompleteSpace H]

/-- An exact divided-difference factorization of the functional-calculus residual. -/
theorem cfc_residual_eq_dslope_apply
    (B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (spectrum ℝ B)) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (v : H) :
    cfc g B v - (g x : ℂ) • v =
      cfc (dslope g x) B (B v - (x : ℂ) • v) := by
  have hs := continuousOn_dslope_of_differentiableAt hg hd
  have hparam : cfc (fun y : ℝ => y - x) B = B - algebraMap ℝ (H →L[ℂ] H) x := by
    rw [cfc_sub (fun y : ℝ => y) (fun _ => x) B continuousOn_id continuousOn_const,
      cfc_id' ℝ B hB, cfc_const x B hB]
  have hop : cfc g B - algebraMap ℝ (H →L[ℂ] H) (g x) =
      cfc (dslope g x) B * (B - algebraMap ℝ (H →L[ℂ] H) x) := by
    rw [← cfc_const (g x) B hB, ← cfc_sub g (fun _ => g x) B hg continuousOn_const,
      ← hparam,
      ← cfc_mul (dslope g x) (fun y => y - x) B hs
        (continuousOn_id.sub continuousOn_const)]
    apply cfc_congr
    intro y _
    simpa only [smul_eq_mul, mul_comm] using (sub_smul_dslope g x y).symm
  have h := congrArg (fun T : H →L[ℂ] H => T v) hop
  simpa [Algebra.algebraMap_eq_smul_one, mul_apply_eq_comp] using h

/-- One fixed bounded divided-difference operator controls every transformed residual. -/
theorem norm_cfc_residual_le
    (B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (spectrum ℝ B)) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x) (v : H) :
    ‖cfc g B v - (g x : ℂ) • v‖ ≤
      ‖cfc (dslope g x) B‖ * ‖B v - (x : ℂ) • v‖ := by
  rw [cfc_residual_eq_dslope_apply B hB g x hg hd]
  exact (cfc (dslope g x) B).le_opNorm _

/-- Vanishing residual transports to the actual functional calculus without a spectral premise. -/
theorem cfc_residual_tendsto_zero
    {ι : Type*} {l : Filter ι}
    (B : H →L[ℂ] H) (hB : IsSelfAdjoint B) (g : ℝ → ℝ) (x : ℝ)
    (hg : ContinuousOn g (spectrum ℝ B)) (hd : DifferentiableAt ℝ g x)
    (v : ι → H) (hv : Tendsto (fun i => ‖B (v i) - (x : ℂ) • v i‖) l (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun i => ‖cfc g B (v i) - (g x : ℂ) • v i‖) l (𝓝 0) :=
  squeeze_zero (fun _ => norm_nonneg _)
    (fun i => norm_cfc_residual_le B hB g x hg hd (v i))
    (by simpa using hv.const_mul ‖cfc (dslope g x) B‖)

end
